title: Waltz encores
summary: After a waltz, bands repeat or switch to 4/4.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: I see. One thing I wondered about waltzes here too. In olden times when you played a waltz Chester and you play it in waltz time, what would happen then if the people applauded after it? Would you go play it in 4-4 or 3-4?
I would play it right back the same way. The same way? Yeah. And then now probably if they still applauded, then you go back in that 3-4, that 4-4.
Now I notice they stop it and then wait a second or a while and then they'll play it in 4-4.
Sometimes they'll stop the 3-4 right in the middle and go into the 4-4.
You hear it both ways. Sometimes they stop in between. That's about the end of the tape.
